description: Create one playable OffStereo card for an ordered listening queue, recording, video, or narrated story. For original recordings, rare mixtapes, or DJ mixes, look on external music/video providers first and use experience=media. Do not search the OffStereo story archive first or create a narrated story unless the listener asks for an OffStereo story. For a quick playlist without narration, use experience=media with tracks for exact catalog songs, or mediaItems to interleave catalog songs, YouTube videos, SoundCloud recordings, and Internet Archive tracks in the requested order. Repeated entries are preserved. Verify any claimed sample relationships before selecting pairs; a quick queue does not require producing a researched story. A bare Archive item URL queues its complete ordered track list; an exact file URL selects that recording. A single external recording can also use sourceUrl or provider-specific search fields. Catalog songs use available previews; external recordings retain their provider's playback limits. Discovery and Music Today already play their songs, so keep those results in their original card unless dedicated controls are requested. experience=single_track remains a one-song shortcut with artist plus track. experience=story progressively creates requested narration; mode=fresh starts a new build. Pass artist plus album for an album story and trackCount for its requested length. Direct queues do not save to a library; save_to_offstereo preserves the selection, while create_playlist exports eligible songs to a music service. existingSessionId opens a saved session; get_session polls an already mounted card. The mounted card owns live progress and playback; avoid restating transient stages in prose. A tool call opens the card without starting playback.

album.description: Exact album or EP title, paired with artist when the listener names or shows a specific record.

artist.description: Exact artist, paired with track for a one-song card or with album for an album-focused story.

existingSessionId.description: The chosen library story id for opening through the canonical player contract; get_session remains application polling.

experience.description: media creates immediate playback without narration: an ordered tracks or mediaItems queue, a complete Archive item, or one recording/video through sourceUrl or provider search. single_track is the existing one-song shortcut; story requests progressive narration. No library save occurs automatically.

length.description: short fits an explicitly quick, brief, or concise narrated story and targets three narration-and-record chapters; standard keeps the full editorial arc.

mediaItems.description: Ordered mixed-media queue for experience=media. Interleave catalog songs, videos, SoundCloud recordings, and Archive item/file links. Use catalog with artist/title; external providers with sourceUrl. Bare Archive items expand in place into all tracks, up to 200 recordings in the final queue. Preserve requested order and repeats. Use instead of tracks or single-source fields; unresolved entries fail the request without saving a partial queue.

artist.description: Exact artist for catalog entries only.

sourceUrl.description: Exact external source URL, required for youtube, soundcloud, or archive.

title.description: Exact song title for catalog entries only.

mediaProvider.description: Provider for a single-source experience=media request. auto identifies sourceUrl; youtube and archive accept a search prompt; soundcloud needs a track URL or exact artist plus track. Here archive means Internet Archive recordings, not the OffStereo story archive. Bare Archive items expand their complete track lists. Omit or use auto with tracks/mediaItems.

mode.description: fresh starts an explicitly new story; auto may reuse an exact strong match.

personalization.description: library uses connected-listener taste as retrieval seeds; none is the default.

prompt.description: For experience=media, the original recording, mixtape, DJ mix, or video to find and play; otherwise what the listening story should explain.

requestId.description: Optional UUID for a new progressive story request. Reuse the same UUID when retrying the same request to avoid duplicate work.

resumeShowId.description: Rebuild an unfinished show in place, keeping its id and URL, instead of creating a second one. Pass the id of a show whose `retryable` is true. Rejected for a show that already finished or that belongs to someone else.

sourceText.description: Source text or conversation context to adapt.

sourceUrl.description: For experience=media, a YouTube video, SoundCloud recording, or Internet Archive item/file URL. A bare Archive item expands its complete ordered track list; a file URL selects one recording. Use mediaItems for multiple sources. For a requested story, an http(s) article or source URL to adapt.

title.description: Short canonical artist, track, album, or subject title for the card, especially useful for an identified image or a prompt that also contains workflow instructions.

track.description: Exact song title, paired with artist for reliable single_track matching.

trackCount.description: Exact number of songs requested for a narrated story (2-12). Use 1 with experience=single_track.

tracks.description: With experience=media, 1–20 exact catalog songs form the entire ordered queue, preserving repeats, without narration or extra curation. Do not combine with mediaItems or a single-source request. With experience=story, these are required records pinned in order while curation fills remaining slots up to trackCount.

videoMode.description: When true, the story opens on a third-person editorial hook with no DJ greeting or time-of-day welcome — for a companion story paired with a video. Pair with an explicit `title` so page title, URL, and register all match the video.

name: make_playable

outputSchema.description: A PlayableSession: one canonical OffStereo card with its ordered narration-and-song queue and live build/playback status.

id.description: Stable session id, reused for get_session and steer_session.

playbackDirective.description: One-shot transport request the mounted card applies.

status.description: Lifecycle: building, partial, ready, failed, and similar.

title: Play music or a story
